full.answer: The main microcontroller on the Arduino UNO R3 is the ATmega328P. The board also includes an ATmega16U2 processor.
The MKR WiFi 1010 uses the Nina W102 wireless module, described as a u-blox NINA-W10 module.
The MKR WAN 1310 uses the Murata CMWX1ZZABZ LoRa module.
The Nicla Sense ME is powered by the nRF52832 SoC within the ANNA-B112 module (MD1).
The Nicla Vision uses the LSM6DSOX 6-axis IMU (U3).
The Nano 33 BLE Rev2's NINA B306 module has 1 MB of Flash and 256 kB of RAM.
On the Arduino UNO R3, the IOREF pin is the reference for digital logic V and is connected to 5V.
Header pin 2, labeled A0/DAC0, can be used as a DAC output.
On the Arduino Nano Every, the SPI clock (SCK) is on pin 1, labeled D13.
On the Nicla Sense ME, the reset pin is P5 on the J2 Fins header, listed as RESET (Digital).
